"Pechi Pechi Hack & Slash" is a hack-and-slash RPG where you defeat monsters, gather materials, and strengthen your character through equipment crafting and skill upgrades.

Defeat enemies, collect materials, and become stronger more efficiently over time.
Enjoy a simple yet highly addictive growth loop.

■ Features
• A replay-focused hack-and-slash RPG centered around defeating monsters and farming materials
• Craft weapons and equipment using collected materials to strengthen your character
• Improve material farming efficiency through a skill tree system
• The stronger you become, the faster your progression accelerates
• Enjoy the satisfying feeling of steadily increasing stats and constant growth

As you progress, your combat power and material farming efficiency will continue to improve, unlocking access to stronger equipment and more powerful skills.

Small upgrades gradually stack up, eventually leading to major growth and progression.

Recommended for players who:
• Love hack-and-slash games
• Enjoy growth systems with constantly increasing numbers
• Like relaxing and steadily progressing at their own pace

Start small, and keep building your growth one step at a time!

Game English Translation

This is a solo-developed pure idle single-player game. The core of the idle mechanics focuses on the process of item acquisition, while the combat segment vividly showcases the stunning battle effects of every attack and skill.

Combat System

Combat adopts a 1V1 turn-based format, centered on 6 core traits and supported by 5 attributes.

Combat Traits: Critical Strike, Combo Attack, Counterattack, Lifesteal, Stun, Dodge

Combat Attributes: Wind, Thunder, Fire, Poison, Water

Different combinations of traits and attributes unlock diverse combat effects.

Unlike traditional idle games that prioritize combat-oriented idling, all items in this game can be obtained automatically through idling—only the combat process cannot be continuously idled. The system places great emphasis on the visual presentation of every combat effect; every effort you invest in character growth will be clearly reflected in tangible, subtle improvements during battles.

There are two types of combat gameplay:

  • Tower Climbing: The higher the tower floor you reach, the more lucrative the items you can obtain after unlocking the Meditation function on the corresponding map.

  • Challenging Powerful NPCs: Successfully defeating them grants direct access to ultra-rare mysterious items, enabling a qualitative leap in combat power.

Game Characters

  • The game offers 10 playable characters.

  • Each character features a unique appearance and exclusive basic trait bonuses.

Equipment System

The gameplay revolves around pure idling, with all equipment acquired through a "box-opening" mechanism: Activate the one-click auto-function, and the game will automatically equip gear and decompose redundant equipment—no manual operation required.

  • Equipment Rarity Tiers (7 tiers, from highest to lowest): Heavenly, Earthly, Profound, Yellow, Upper, Middle, Lower. Higher rarity provides more substantial attribute bonuses.

  • Core Equipment Attributes: Attack Power, Defense, Health Points (HP), Agility.

  • Additional Random Attributes: Critical Strike Chance, Counterattack Chance, Lifesteal Chance, Dodge Chance, Stun Chance, Combo Chance.

  • Resistance Attributes: Critical Strike Resistance, Counterattack Resistance, Lifesteal Resistance, Dodge Resistance, Stun Resistance, Combo Resistance.

The equipment system only enhances basic physical output and trait trigger probabilities.

Spiritual Core System

The Spiritual Core System is a supplementary gameplay to the Equipment System, corresponding to the five combat attributes (Wind, Thunder, Fire, Poison, Water).

Spiritual Cores function like a "doppelgänger" mechanism and can be upgraded to unlock new skills: Each attribute's Spiritual Core is equipped with 3 passive skills and 1 Rage Active Skill.

Identity System

The Identity System complements the Spiritual Core System, providing attribute-less damage bonuses to the five core attributes (Wind, Thunder, Fire, Poison, Water).

It includes Refining and Cultivation gameplay, along with minor enhancements to basic physical attributes.

Other Gameplay

Equipment Enhancement & Refinement

  • Enhancement: Consumes items to boost equipment's basic attributes.

  • Refinement: Consumes items to increase equipment's trait trigger probabilities.

    Note: Enhancement and Refinement effects are bound to equipment slots—levels will not reset when replacing gear.

Star Disk

All directly usable items can be crafted via Star Disk recipes. The entire crafting process is fully automated through idling, with no manual intervention needed.

Workshop

Silver, along with Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, and Earth materials obtained during idling, can be used as currency to exchange for desired items in the Workshop.

Main City

Serving as the core hub of the game world, the Main City is a key venue for plot development and future content expansions.

Three days before the baby arrives.

The hallway outside the delivery room is quiet. Phone screens light up and fade; the ward door opens and closes. A man who has never been a father stands at the threshold of his own life, learning how to become someone else.

Three Days is a narrative visual novel adapted from real life. Set in the three days before a baby is born, it follows a first-time father through the most ordinary of days: hospital corridors, late-night convenience stores, words left unsaid.

Your choices decide where these relationships go

No combat, no puzzles. Just every word spoken, and every silence kept, in conversations with his wife, his family, and himself. Each choice leads the story in a different direction.

A quiet experience

About one hour per playthrough. A gentle pace, best read on a quiet night. Different choices lead to different narrative paths, worth revisiting.

Language

Currently available in Simplified Chinese. English, Japanese, and Korean versions are in progress.

Wishlist Three Days and walk with him through the first three days before he becomes a father.

About This Game

Path of Immortal Dust is a cultivation simulation game centered on narrative and strategy.

Cultivation and Breakthroughs

The game runs on a turn-based time system. Each turn grants you a set of action points, which can be spent on training techniques, advancing your cultivation realm, or venturing out to explore. Techniques require accumulated proficiency to level up, with each tier demanding greater effort. Realm breakthroughs require full cultivation progress and the right pill to ascend to the next major stage. Your innate talents—such as Bone Structure and Comprehension—affect training efficiency, and every breakthrough permanently strengthens your character.

Exploration and Events

Spend action points to travel to different locations and trigger random events. These events unfold through a multi-stage narrative system—you will meet a variety of characters and face meaningful choices. Some choices affect your relationships, some unlock new locations or follow-up events, and some will draw you into battle.

Combat System

Combat is turn-based, with you and your enemies taking alternating actions. You can use basic attacks, equipped divine abilities, artifacts, and talismans. The combat system features an energy mechanic, cooldowns, and status effects—you'll need to plan each turn carefully. Defeating powerful foes rewards you with cultivation progress, spirit stones, and rare items.

A World of Relationships

The sect is home to many characters with distinct personalities, waiting for you to befriend them. Give gifts, complete character-specific events, and raise affinity. Your relationships will evolve from strangers to trusted allies, and may even lead to unique ending paths.

Cultivation is part of everyday life


Spiritual energy returned decades ago. Cultivation is now as much a part of modern life as school, work, and starting a family. Flying-sword classes have exams. Passing probation means winning a duel. And Mom still compares you to someone else's kid.

You Can Do Better! (别人家孩子都筑基了！) is a modern-day cultivation life sim with automatic battles. Each run follows a life from childhood to old age. When this life ends, the next generation carries on.

Put your techniques in order before the fight


You can learn plenty of techniques, but only bring a few into battle. Before each fight, choose your techniques and arrange their order. Once the fight begins, they activate in that sequence without any further input.

Use "Sink Your Qi" to build Momentum, then spend it on a "Basic Strike." Some techniques set up the next move. Others need the right conditions to shine. The same techniques in a different order can lead to a very different result.

You can see your opponent's techniques and their order before the fight. When a reliable setup stops working, swap a few techniques and rearrange them. As you reach higher cultivation realms, you can bring more techniques into battle.

How will you spend this year?


Cultivate, pursue further studies, or head out to explore? School sparring matches, challenges at work, and inner demons faced during breakthroughs all call on the skills you've learned in this life.

The PE teacher is "off sick" again, so it's another techniques class. Your Lunar New Year money comes in spirit stones, and Mom still wants to keep it safe for you. Familiar childhood moments turn up again, with a cultivation twist.

Someone mentions the kid next door over dinner. You keep your head down and finish your meal. After washing the dishes, you hear a phone call from the balcony: "Our kid's doing pretty well, too."

Lose some battles and you miss out on a reward. Lose at certain turning points and this life comes to an end.

What one life leaves to the next


At the end of a life, look back on the path you've taken and leave one final wish for the next generation: build a solid foundation, give the child a better life, or see more of the world. You'll hear those words when your next life begins.

The person holding you when you're born is you from your previous life.

Spend the Family Points you've earned on legacy bonuses, and pass the family heirlooms you've found to the next generation. Give the next life a better place to start.

The next generation picks up where this life left off. As for how many generations it takes for someone to ascend, nobody knows yet.

A few more things


  • Start life as a boy or a girl.
  • A single-player game with a one-time purchase, no in-game purchases, and no internet connection required to play.
  • The demo is available now on Steam.
  • Questions, suggestions, or a bug to report? We'd love to hear from you.

Your character will charge, shoot, reload, and throw grenades on their own. Your job is to plan their growth path, then occasionally tap the keyboard or click the mouse to remind them that, yes, they can absolutely work harder.

Sinkhole Outlaw Chase, the first suspense-adventure live-action interactive game under Tianxia Bachang's IP, is coming soon!

Cross the mountains—fate can be reversed!

Deep in the primeval forests of Laoyeling in Northeast China, a joint scientific expedition team of Chinese and foreign scholars ventures into the mountains for exploration—only for the entire team to vanish without a trace, leaving no word behind.

An emergency rescue mission is immediately launched. You are Zhao Gong, a rescue team leader summoned at a critical moment, skilled both in communications repair and Japanese translation. Joining you are the seasoned hunter Da Saibangzi, guard Xiao Chen, archaeologist Shirley, and a Japanese research team including geology professor Takagi Ichiro, assistant Nakayama Ranko, and Kobayashi Kenji. Together, you rush into the dense forest to search for the missing expedition members.

The treasures of the Golden Forest and the secrets beneath the earth—dig deep, and the final outcome is yours to decide.

Undercurrents stir within the team: Chinese and foreign members hold differing stances and conceal unpredictable intentions; deep-rooted prejudices of the mountain villagers and mounting internal conflicts within the rescue team threaten to erupt at any moment. As tensions reach a standoff, strange occurrences begin to unfold in the dark forest: an unseen mysterious force drives the group away, eerie flying monkeys launch repeated attacks, and danger closes in step by step.

A sudden accident sends the entire rescue team plunging into an isolated, hidden sinkhole. Forbidden mountain grounds and underground mysteries emerge layer by layer, while all manner of bizarre events follow one after another. The truth behind the expedition team's disappearance, the source of the forest's anomalies, and the millennia-old secrets buried deep within the sinkhole—a tangled web of mysteries awaits discovery.

In addition, the sound design of Sinkhole Outlaw Chase is built around "virtual panoramic audio" as its core feature, elevating sound from an atmospheric support element in traditional film and television into an integral part of the interactive gaming experience.

Through virtual panoramic audio technology, a multi-directional, three-dimensional sound field is simulated on ordinary stereo devices. Without any professional multi-channel equipment, players wearing regular headphones can feel sound coming from different directions—front, back, left, right, near, far, high, and low—as if they were truly standing inside the deep, unfathomable sinkhole.

At the same time, ambient sounds, action sound effects, and emotional music all contribute to the narrative, intensifying the sense of immediacy in suspenseful exploration, bandit pursuit, and life-and-death choices. Players are not merely "watching" a suspenseful manhunt—they are perceiving the scene and discerning direction with their own ears, personally experiencing every moment of the unknown and every life-or-death decision.

The earlier guests who obeyed the rules left nothing in the register but their names.

At night you're stuck in one room of an old Japanese inn. You can't walk over to check on a noise.
The rules that appear on the wall are all you have.
"When a shadow appears, lower your eyes." You have memorized that rule. So: was that a shadow moving behind the paper screen just now, or did you imagine it?
The night won't wait for you to decide.

Not sure it's for you? The free demo (Nights 1–3) is a good place to start.

What you do

By night: watch the room from your futon. A faint sound, a shadow, a flicker in the lamplight—find what is wrong.
When you find it, perform the rite the rules demand. Each rule has its own: pour oil into the lamp, don't look back, lower your eyes. New rites join them after Night 3.
While an anomaly is in the room, traces of earlier guests (clues) can surface by the walls and beside your futon. Stare at a trace to note it—but the anomaly does not stop while you stare.

By morning: open the inn's register. Match the traces you noted against the life stories written in the margin, and work out page by page who each earlier guest was and how they died.

The rites are easy to memorize. What is hard is deciding, in the dark, whether you can take your eyes off the anomaly right now to note a trace.

Nights you must not follow the rules

The rules never lie. But some nights, something not in the rules arrives disguised as something that is.
Then the rite the rules demand is the one that hands you over. Judge wrong, and morning will not come.

The same thing won't necessarily come the same way twice

The full game has 40 anomalies across 34 kinds (the demo shows only some). Even the same kind can appear on a different surface, at a different size and distance, from one run to the next. On some nights, one of the rules on the wall cannot be read. The reaction that was fast enough last night may be too slow tonight. That is why you go back in—to find out how it comes for you next.
Each dawn adds to the rules, so there is more to remember and more to watch.
The full game has multiple endings, and your seven nights decide which morning you wake to. (The demo stops after Night 3.)

Easy to pick up. Nowhere to run.

  • Mouse plus the E key (lower or raise the lamp shade). Esc pauses.
  • At night there is no movement and no inventory—only looking and the rites.
  • If you misjudge, you can retry the night from its start.
  • In the full game, one run takes you through seven nights in a row.
  • Text in Japanese, English, and Simplified Chinese.
  • Headphones recommended, at a modest volume.

If you have a heart condition, or are sensitive to light or sound, please lower the volume, play in a well-lit room, and take breaks. You can also reduce flashing and screen shake in Options.

Streaming, Video, and Let's Play Policy

Streams and videos of Rules of the Inn are welcome, even if you only play the demo. No application and no individual permission is needed, so long as you keep to the terms below. I love watching Let's Plays, and if you post one, I will come and watch it.

You are the Emperor of the Great Ming. You will play as Chongzhen, the last emperor of the Ming dynasty, ruling an empire besieged by crises within and without. Will you turn the tide and forge a restoration — or repeat the fate of hanging yourself on Coal Hill? Every audience with your civil and military officials is a drama played out at court. Suspicion or trust, compromise or resolve — the fate of the realm hangs on a single thought of yours.A Dynasty on the Brink of Collapse In the seventeenth year of the Chongzhen reign, the Ming dynasty teeters amid civil war, natural disasters, and factional strife. Li Zicheng's rebel army closes in on the capital, iron cavalry hammers at the frontier walls beyond the passes, the treasury stands empty, and every man at court harbors his own schemes.

A realm long tormented by factionalism and harsh rule yearns for a wise sovereign. The situation shifts by the hour — enemies press in from every side, and military dispatches arrive without cease. Can you lead the Ming out of its decline? The future of the dynasty rests on your choices. Take care, Your Majesty.

Whom Will You Trust? Work side by side with your ministers day and night, forging a style of governance for this court — iron-fisted or benevolent. Issue edicts, form alliances, and balance the factions to bring welfare to the people — or to serve yourself. But remember: every minister is played by AI in real time, each with their own ideals and their own agenda. They will flatter, conceal, form cliques — and even defy your edicts to your face. Choose your friends carefully; choose your enemies even more carefully.

One Edict, and the Realm Trembles Every decree you issue ripples outward, layer by layer: new levies spark peasant uprisings, reforms enrage the gentry, pardons unsettle the border garrisons. Prestige, popular support, corruption, and factional power rise and fall in turn — every crisis you face is born of your own decisions.

Leave the Palace in Disguise, See the Truth with Your Own Eyes When the memorials whitewash reality, travel incognito among your subjects and see for yourself: grain prices posted on the rice-shop wall, barefoot children in the streets, the rot concealed beneath official reports — secrets known only to you and the ministers who accompany you.

Build the hand. Watch the damage climb.

Your weapon in Wizard Cards is an evolving deck. Combine class cards, trigger hand patterns and tactics, and turn base damage and multipliers into a strategy. Watch cards resolve one by one and the damage reel roll as your build takes on its next opponent.

Find the right combination


Warriors, Mages, Rangers and Necromancers bring different skills to your deck. Focus on one class to form a powerful hand, or explore combinations across classes. Decide what to play and what to keep: both playing and discarding require careful use of limited stamina. Damage previews help you compare your options.

Explore builds that work together


Strengthen class skills and hand patterns, stack tactics for damage and multipliers, or find synergies between card growth and resource management. Enchantments and Devour are just two of the options you may encounter. Focus on one approach or combine several in the same deck, then add blessings and manually activated emergency cards. Keep adapting to the cards you find and discovering new combinations.

Make the shop part of your strategy


Spend battle earnings on cards, tactics and other items, or refresh the shop for new possibilities. Random offerings can strengthen your current plan or suggest a different combination. Limited gold and slots make buying, selling and holding on to resources meaningful choices.

Face nine acts of changing challenges


The full game contains nine acts and 27 battles, with two regular encounters and one boss in each act. Travel through ruined cities, an astral academy and ancient forests on your way to the final court. Boss modifiers ask you to rethink the hand patterns and resources your build relies on.

A tutorial introduces the basics, and autosave lets you continue between sessions. Win or lose, start another run to explore different shop choices and builds.

The free Demo covers the first three acts and nine battles. Wishlist the full game to follow news about the Demo and Wizard Cards.

31 interface languages


Menus, interface text and card descriptions are available in 31 languages. Change language in the game. We will continue improving the translations and welcome your feedback.

A relaxing idle, deep progression, free class-switching fantasy medieval idle RPG featuring pet taming, equipment forging, and a mount system. No need to stay glued to the screen—whether you're working, studying, or resting, as long as the progress bar moves forward, your character grows stronger. Your fantastical beasts grow too, gear upgrades never pause, and your mount explores and accumulates progress on its own.

Game Feature 1 – Effortless Idle
Grow while away – Auto-battle, auto-loot, full offline rewards. Even pet training and enhancement materials are collected automatically while idle. Your mount’s exploration and growth happen without manual input. Just log in, collect rewards, and enjoy simultaneous progression for your character, pets, gear, and mount with minimal time investment.

Game Feature 2 – Free Class Switching
Build your unique playstyle – Warrior, Mage, Archer, Priest… Freely switch between multiple class paths. Combine different skills, stats, and gear with pet bonds and skill bonuses, plus mount stat boosts, to create your own distinctive build and double your tactical edge.

Game Feature 3 – Companion Fantastical Beasts
Grow together through taming and training – On this medieval continent full of magic and adventure, fantastical beasts of all shapes and attributes await. Challenge wild beasts and dungeon boss beasts, then use strategy to tame them as your exclusive partners. Through feeding, training, and bond development, unlock unique pet skills. Your once‑tiny companion grows into a powerful ally, fighting alongside you and your mount as you explore the continent’s mysteries.

Game Feature 4 – Gear Enhancement & Synthesis
Break through power limits – Looted gear can be worn directly or pushed further via enhancement and synthesis. Use extra gear as materials for advanced synthesis to forge epic legendary items. Consume materials to enhance gear attributes. Whether you equip your character, synergize with pet bonds, or outfit your mount, you’ll unlock greater power to tackle high‑level dungeons and powerful bosses.

Game Feature 5 – Exclusive Mount
Dual assistance in exploration and combat – Unlock a variety of unique mounts. They’re not just cool companions for travel—they also explore autonomously. Without your direct control, your mount roams the continent, discovers hidden areas, and gathers rare gear and special items, saving you time. Meanwhile, mounts wear their own gear to boost stats, assisting you in battle with both attacks and damage reduction, becoming an indispensable partner on your adventures.

Game Feature 6 – Fantasy Medieval World Exploration
Roam a land of magic and adventure – Ride your mount across the continent, challenge monsters, dungeons, and bosses, and unlock hidden maps and storylines. Collect gear, learn skills, tame fantastical beasts, and train your mount. With every step, uncover the world’s mysterious tale and find new surprises.

Game Feature 7 – Long‑Term Replayability
Continuous content updates – As development progresses, new classes, maps, dungeons, systems, and gameplay modes will be added, along with more fantastical beast species, equipment synthesis recipes, enhancement mechanics, and mount types with exclusive features. Your feedback shapes the game’s future—so the adventure never ends.

Fantasy Progress Bar is for every player who loves idle relaxation without sacrificing RPG depth. Start the game, watch the progress bar move forward, and let your worries fade. Your character, fantastical beasts, and mount grow stronger, your gear advances, and your fantasy medieval adventure begins.

What is with all these youkai popping up everywhere—?!

About the Game

Youkai have appeared.
A lot of them have appeared.

No, far too many have appeared.
This is definitely an incident.

But there’s no need to worry.
The way things work in Gensokyo is always simple.

Beat them all up first, find the culprit later.


幻想郷大激突 : Touhou Impact is a casual bullet-hell survival roguelite where you roam 3D battlefields and wipe out endless hordes of youkai. Your attacks fire automatically, but it’s entirely up to you where to run, which experience orbs to collect, and what upgrades to choose.

You start with just one small attack.
But as you level up, lightning will chain between youkai, lasers will pierce through entire lines, auras will melt everything nearby, and projectiles will scatter in all directions.

At some point, you might start wondering if you’re resolving the Incident or making it worse!


The battlefield isn’t flat.
Climb hills, navigate the terrain, and find openings before the youkai surround you. The attacks handle themselves, but dodging is all on you.

Gather experience to level up and create your own style of youkai extermination with randomized upgrades.

With good luck, you’ll put together an awesome build.
Even with bad luck... well, you’ll still be firing a lot of bullets.

Key Features

  • Incident-solving survival action against massive youkai hordes

  • Casual bullet-hell roguelite gameplay in 3D battlefields

  • Simple auto-attack controls

  • EXP orb collection and randomized upgrades

  • Flashy lightning, laser, aura, and projectile combinations

  • Movement and dodging across elevated terrain

  • Escalating swarms, bullets, and chaos

Every general piece is granted a unique skill inspired by historical allusions. Players can move pieces, destroy opponent pieces, place consecutive stones, and even redefine the rules—turning standard Gomoku into a four-stone victory game.

Whenever your pieces form a straight or diagonal line of five, the connected pieces are removed from the board, and you gain 1 point.

A single match lasts 40 rounds. The player with the higher score at the end wins.

If scores are tied after 40 rounds, the remaining pieces on the board are counted for tiebreaker points: general pieces worth 2 points each, and soldier pieces worth 1 point each.

This rule creates endless possibilities for creative and strategic gameplay.

A world where an endless rain of iron has turned the sky to ash. Summoned by Valdis, the goddess of last rites, you awaken in the body of a valkyrie who fell a thousand years ago — and spread your wings into a sky of bullets. Your only weapon: the knack for dodging that was the one thing you were ever good at, in the life before this one.

Barrage of Valhalla is a vertical bullet-hell shoot 'em up crossed with hack-and-slash RPG progression, built on two pillars: the skill to dodge and the joy to grow. Thread the needle for the pride of a top rank, or grind gear and buffs and bull your way through. Both are the right answer.

① Four classes, four ways to fly

Each class turns the same stage into a completely different game.

  • Swordsman — Melee sweeps. The only class that cuts enemy bullets from the air; every bullet you slice charges your gauge. An aggressive tank.

  • Bowman — Multi-way and homing shots, the classic shmup pick. Bullets converge when you focus-move. A great first pick.

  • Magician — Devastating placement spells cast from a standstill. Your weapon is the courage to stop moving.

  • Summoner — Familiars fight on their own while you focus on positioning.

Every class branches into eight advanced classes (subclasses), then grows into a build that's yours through the rebirth system.

② The skill to dodge, and the joy to grow

Dodge everything for an S rank, or push through with gear and cooking buffs — your call.

  • No-miss, high-kill runs earn an S–C rank. Your best scores are recorded on per-stage, per-class leaderboards.

  • Stack levels, gear and food buffs and you can power through even while taking hits. A lives system plus continues means "I can't clear this" never happens.

  • Want an edge? Hard Mode — one hit ends it, and enemies grow relentlessly stronger over time. A single, all-or-nothing run.

③ Read the weak points, break the armor

Bosses aren't just targets to dodge.

  • In armored phases, damage bounces off. Wait for the weak-point core to expose itself in the gap — then punch through.

  • Damage is color-coded (white = normal, yellow = crit, orange = weak point, gray "1" = armor), so you can read what's landing without reading numbers.

  • Five boss fights, each with shifting barrage phases. Lay to rest the fallen guardians the world left behind.

④ A quiet life between sorties

Runevik, the hidden village the rain never reaches. Nine facilities keep your next sortie stocked.

  • Fishing, farming, cooking — turn what you gather into meals that become stat buffs for your next run.

  • Your farm keeps growing the whole time the game is open, and bears fruit every time you return from a mission.

  • Forge, enhance, arrange your rune board, train skills — a hub you roam to get ready.

⑤ An honest, one-time purchase

  • No stamina. No loss on failed upgrades. No paywalls. Everything is playable from the start.

  • Create multiple characters and pass gear between them through a shared storage. Alts are quick to raise.

  • One purchase. All of it.

What's included (full volume, at launch)

  • 5 areas × 25 missions total (Misty Floating Citadel / Iron Foundry City / Molten Volcano / Storm Canopy / The Divine Realm) plus Hard Mode for every area

  • 4 classes + 8 subclass branches + rebirth growth + rune board

  • Equipment system (per-slot gear, enhancement, repair, salvage, rarities / shared storage)

  • Three life-content pillars (12 fish, 8 crops, 12 cooking recipes) / a 9-facility hub

  • Story cutscenes (illustrated storybook style), a codex, and achievements (Steam Achievements)

  • Score attack and leaderboards (local records + online score leaderboards)

  • 11 music tracks / full key rebinding / accessibility options (bullet-visibility presets, always-on hitbox display, adjustable screen-effect intensity, and more)

  • 10 languages (see §5) / full controller support / single-player

※ Online is used only for score leaderboards and cloud saves. There is no co-op or competitive multiplayer.

然而一位转校生的到来，彻底终结了他平静的日常。

她叫铃木静，一位沉默寡言但是武力值爆表的少女，自称是受雇来保护秦越的贴身保镖。

Idle Legend is a single-player idle loot-driven ARPG. With fully automated combat, you can enjoy the pure thrill of watching powerful gear rain from the skies while you work, relax, or even sleep!

◆ Classic Legacy: Warrior, Mage & Taoist — One Character, Endless Builds

Break free from the limitations of traditional single-class systems. Freely combine dozens of iconic legendary skills, including Blazing Sword, Ice Storm, Soul Fire Talisman, Summon Divine Beast, and more.

Create your own unique combat build. Will you become a high-speed berserker with extreme lifesteal, a mighty spellcaster capable of raining destruction across the entire battlefield, or a Taoist master commanding deadly poison and powerful summons? The choice is yours!

◆ Ultimate Loot Hunt: Endless Affixes & Crimson Moon Weapons

  • Massive Loot Pool & Random Affixes: From basic white gear to legendary Crimson Moon equipment and Mythic gear, every item you find comes with its own randomized stats and unique affixes.

  • Deep Crafting & Enhancement: Strengthen equipment at the Blacksmith, forge powerful gear in the Crimson Moon Furnace, lock and reroll affixes, and temper artifacts. Turn every great drop into a weapon worthy of slaying gods.

  • Set Resonance: Collect iconic sets such as Celestial, Arcane, and Saint Warrior gear to activate powerful set bonuses and push your combat power beyond its limits.

◆ Endless Challenges: Demon Tower & Illusion Maze

  • Demon Tower: Climb a towering fortress filled with demons, where each floor tests your character's power, attributes, and resistances. Reach key milestones to claim generous rewards and unlock new Rebirth opportunities.

  • Illusion Maze: Venture deep into high-risk, high-reward hidden realms. Defeat ancient world bosses and claim rare crafting materials and powerful artifacts.

The game features a complete offline progression system, so there's no need to leave your PC running overnight.

No matter how long you're away, simply log back in and collect massive amounts of Gold, EXP, enhancement materials, and rare equipment with a single click. Grow stronger effortlessly, with zero grinding pressure.

《方块战场 Block Battlefield》 is a light Roguelike game that combines real-time falling blocks with auto-battler combat.

By clearing different blocks, you can deploy Archers, Knights, Mages, Spearmen, Shieldbearers, Physicians, and Sappers. You can also promote them into more powerful advanced classes. Along the way, choose from random upgrades during block-clearing to build a mighty block army, defeat your enemies, and ultimately destroy the enemy fortress — conquering the entire block battlefield!

At the age of twenty-seven, Bijia broke away from the crowded city and rigid institutional work, resigned quietly, and returned to her hometown alone.

Without telling her family or making any backup plans, she only wanted to steal a moment of respite from suffocating social conventions and relentless marriage pressure.

She thought coming home would be a peaceful fresh start and a journey of self-redemption, but old ties and new encounters came to her all at once.

Bai Shengfei, Zhang You, Pei Yihe and Xu Nanying walked into her peaceful life, bringing entanglement, regret, rebirth and redemption along with them.

Through quiet monochrome visuals and a first-person perspective, live through a realistic tale of breaking free, healing, obsession and reconciliation.

Every choice you make will alter the course of these meetings, shift the delicate bonds between characters, and unlock exclusive story branches and various endings.

Game Features

• Realistic poignant healing narrative: Centered on family of origin issues, marriage pressure, self-liberation and female growth, portraying the helplessness and redemption of adults.

• Literary plain writing style: Restrained and refined wording with no forced sentimentality, capturing a unique fragile emotional texture through understated description.

• Black-and-white hand-drawn artwork: A muted visual tone that matches the story’s bleak, wistful and gentle mood.

• Full first-person perspective: Fully immersive experience of every meeting, regret and decision.

• Branching storyline with 12 distinct endings; your choices determine the direction of every character’s bond.

• Deep connections among female characters: Tender reciprocal emotional bonds between women, depicting the unique salvation and resonance shared only by women.

Japan Scenic Puzzle is a single-player puzzle journey through Okayama, Tottori, Shimane, Yamaguchi, and Hiroshima. Meet local guides and explore the scenery and culture of Japan's Chugoku region.

Find differences between pictures, piece together jigsaw puzzles, and answer quizzes about the places you visit. Each prefecture offers three games, followed by a final challenge connecting the region.

Take your time and use hints as you explore. Text is available in Japanese, regional dialects, and English. Progress is saved locally on your computer and can be resumed later. Steam Cloud syncing between devices is not supported.

The free demo includes the first chapter in Okayama. The full game includes all five prefectures and the final challenge.

I'm experimenting with combining map-based grand strategy with AI simulation to see what emerges. The game supports most of the systems you would expect from a traditional grand strategy game, and its world can run entirely without AI. AI takes over the core "dice-rolling" stage, opening up even more possibilities. Technologies, national policies, characters, factions, and almost everything else are no longer limited to predefined entries and progression trees.

Please note: AI expands the game's freedom and enriches its world. The language model is given access to over 50 tools that let it query and modify game data—that's the extent of its role. World simulation, population growth and decline, food consumption and production, tax calculations, changes to regional task status, military casualties, and other underlying systems are all calculated by the game's code.

Clarifications


At present, the LLM supplements the game's freedom, worldbuilding, and immersion by replacing the "dice rolls" found in traditional strategy games. This feature can be turned off. The underlying world simulation runs independently of the LLM. Unless AI simulation intervenes, other factions act according to programmed strategies.

Game Systems


  • National policies

  • Technology

  • Taxation

  • Court politics

  • Regional management

  • Military

  • Diplomacy

  • Map exploration

  • Weapons

  • Buildings

This is an Two-player online competitive game where players place on the board the girls of Gensokyo and vie for supremacy in their precious bonds (friendship).

Specifically, like in “Five in a Row,” you place character cards as stones in straight lines to increase your overall precious bonds (the points needed to win).

However, since the goal is to compete for the friendship, the characters placed next to each other must be friends.

Abilities

Each character has unique abilities, such as “placing multiple stones in one move” or “destroying the opponent's stones,” among others.

In particular, the “Spell Card,” which can be used once per match, is extremely powerful, and its usage can significantly influence the outcome of the game.

Movement and Pushing

Placed stones can be moved later or used to push other stones, depending on each character’s movement points.

This allows for more flexible gameplay.

Deck

Like many TCGs (Trading Card Games), you can freely select cards from your collection

to build your deck.

To achieve overall precious bonds, it's essential that adjacent cards work well together,

so deck construction requires more conscious synergy than other TCGs.

Game Modes

In addition to Ranked Matches and Free Matches,

we plan to hold limited-time “Event Matches” with modified rules, such as

“more Spell Cards available” and “points are awarded even if players are friends of friends.”

You might find some unexpected cards proving useful...

Puzzle Mode

Similar to shogi problems, there is a puzzle mode where you score points or

prevent the enemy from scoring points within a set board configuration and number of turns.

There are over 20 different stages.

About Wolf in Woof

This is a Werewolf game you can enjoy all by yourself!

No need to gather players. No need to drag your friends in. You’ll jump straight into a chaotic, hilarious match with a group of dogs who may look adorable, but definitely have their own little schemes.

These dogs are not that simple.

Don’t be fooled by their cute faces — they can:

make nonsense sound totally serious,
blame others with full confidence,
take sides in public while plotting in secret,
and even team up to pull off something big.

Every dog has its own personality and playstyle. You might run into:

a Shiba Inu who loves stirring things up,
a Border Collie who refuses to admit anything,
or a Golden Retriever with the most innocent face imaginable.

And your job is simple:

Find the wolf hiding among the dogs.

Every match is a new story.

There are no fixed routines and no standard answers.

The speaking order can change. Alliances can shift. The situation can flip at any moment.

You think you’re doing the deduction — but they’re also reading you.

Developer: Tandao Studio

We’re a team of game creators who love Werewolf. We want to turn the clash of wild ideas and sharp logic into an immersive experience you can start anytime.

We hope Wolf in Woof brings players not only the thrill of deduction, but also unexpected sparks of interaction.

《疾风群侠传》是一款融合武侠养成、多周目Roguelike、门派分支与角色养成的单机游戏。

这里没有唯一正确的江湖道路。你将从一名尚未踏入江湖的无名少年开始，在有限的回合中安排修炼、调整属性、研习武学、获取装备，并应对随机出现的见闻、奇遇与战斗。

Welcome to Game of Gods

If you could choose any characters from an era, a league, or a fantasy world and bring them together to form your ultimate dream team, who would you pick—and where would you place them?

In Game of Gods, you select characters, assign their positions, and build a team around the theme of each mode. Once the match begins, it plays out automatically according to a complete set of predefined rules. Each character’s abilities, role, synergy, and in-match performance contribute to the final result.

You do not need to control every action yourself. However, every decision you make before the match begins could determine whether your team wins or loses.

Gameplay Overview

Every character has their own abilities, role, and defining traits.

A powerful character may not be suitable for every position, and filling your team with the highest-rated characters does not necessarily create the best lineup. Some characters excel as the team’s core, some specialize in offense, some control the pace of the match, while others transform the team through support, protection, or resource management.

You will need to consider:

  • Whether each character is suited to their assigned position

  • Whether the lineup has a complete and balanced set of capabilities

  • Whether the characters can create effective synergies

  • Whether the team has any obvious weaknesses

  • Whether the lineup can adapt to the conditions of the current theme

Assigning the right character to the right role is often more important than simply pursuing individual strength.

Complete Simulations Under Predefined Rules

Every match follows rules established by the game.

You cannot change those rules once a match has begun, nor can you directly control the outcome. During the simulation, the system continuously evaluates both teams based on character ratings, suitability for assigned roles, lineup synergies, matchups and counters, environmental factors, and event outcomes.

Different modes may use different rules, but every mode has clear and consistent victory conditions. Every lineup is tested under the same rules.

You build the team. The simulation system brings it to life.

Every Character Influences the Match

Game of Gods does more than display a simple win-or-lose result at the end.

Throughout the match, every character can have a clear impact. Core characters may improve the performance of the entire team, offensive characters can create advantages, support characters can stabilize the situation, and special characters may change the course of the match at a critical moment.

Characters may also activate synergies with one another:

  • Familiar partners can coordinate more effectively

  • Characters with complementary abilities can compensate for each other’s weaknesses

  • Characters with similar styles can form stronger tactical systems

  • Characters with conflicting roles may be unable to perform at their full potential

  • Certain combinations may activate unique effects

The same character may perform very differently depending on their assigned position and the teammates around them.

Multiple Themes, Different Battlegrounds

Game of Gods is not limited to a single setting.

The game can feature many different types of lineup-based competition, including:

  • Wars between historical figures and their factions

  • Lineup battles between basketball players from different eras

  • Dream football teams composed of players from across the sport

  • Crossover battles between anime characters

  • Contests of ability between video game characters

  • Other themes featuring their own characters and rule systems

Each theme has its own positions, attributes, synergies, and victory conditions. To find the best possible lineup, you must first understand the rules of the mode you are playing.

It Is Not About the Strongest Character—It Is About the Strongest Team

A team’s strength is more than the sum of its characters’ ratings.

Some lineups possess overwhelming power but lack stability. Others may have no outstanding individual stars, yet consistently gain the upper hand through strong role assignments and character synergies. Some teams excel at establishing an early advantage but gradually lose control during a prolonged contest.

What truly determines victory is whether the entire lineup can function effectively under the established rules.

Choose your characters. Assign their positions. Complete your lineup, and then begin the simulation.

You decide who gets the chance to enter the arena.

The rules decide who deserves to make it to the end.

🌸 A Dream of the Red Chamber, Shaped by Your Choices

Red Chamber Chronicle is a story-rich life simulation and multi-ending narrative game inspired by the classic Chinese novel Dream of the Red Chamber.

Step into the role of Jia Baoyu and enter a living, immersive world where you can explore, build relationships, and reshape destinies. Travel freely between the Grand View Garden, the Jia family's noble estates, and the capital city as you experience an unforgettable journey through prosperity, emotion, and fate.

🌿 Live Through an Entire Red Chamber Life

Experience the changing seasons and relive Baoyu's life from youth to adulthood.

From an innocent young heir born into a powerful aristocratic family to a person caught between tradition, duty, and genuine emotion, every decision you make will influence relationships, events, and the future of the world around you.

There is no single fixed ending.

Form bonds with the Twelve Beauties of Jinling and many other beloved characters from the original novel. Unlock exclusive storylines, private conversations, hidden events, and alternative destinies.

Each character possesses their own personality, emotional journey, and branching fate. Your choices will determine where those paths ultimately lead.

🌸 Experience a Living Aristocratic World

Join poetry gatherings, solve lantern riddles, enjoy banquets, burn incense, play the guqin, stroll through gardens, read, write, brew tea, and create fragrances.

Immerse yourself in the refined daily life of an ancient noble household and discover the beauty of traditional Chinese culture.

As time passes, the world continuously changes:

Flowers bloom and wither, lanterns flicker in the night, and people move through their daily routines, creating a dynamic and ever-evolving Red Chamber world.

🏮 Explore Multiple Regions

The Grand View Garden

The heart of poetry, friendship, and romance.

The Ning and Rong Mansions

A world of family power, social hierarchy, and tradition.

The Capital City

A larger society where opportunities, conflicts, and destinies unfold.

Freely travel between locations, discover events, meet characters, and experience unique stories shaped by where you go and whom you encounter.

💫 Key Features

✨ Multiple Endings and Branching Destinies

Your decisions shape both the characters and the world itself.

Create your own version of the Red Chamber story—whether it becomes a tale of fulfillment, regret, seclusion, redemption, or something entirely different.

Every playthrough offers new possibilities.

✨ Deep Relationship System

Every major character features unique affection systems, story branches, and personal events.

From first meetings to lifelong bonds, experience character journeys beyond what was told in the original novel.

✨ A Time-Driven Living World

NPCs follow schedules, appear in different locations, and react differently depending on the season, time, and circumstances.

The world is not a static backdrop—it continues to live and change alongside you.

✨ Life Simulation and Character Growth

Practice poetry, music, strategy games, household management, social activities, and personal development.

Build your own path through the world of the Red Chamber.

Between duty and sincerity.

Between destiny and choice.

You will constantly face decisions that shape the lives of those around you.

Will you follow the tragic course of the original story?

Or will you challenge fate itself and create a new future for everyone?

Before prosperity fades away, the final chapter is yours to write.

May this dream of the Red Chamber leave no regrets.

🎮 How This Game Began

The beginning of Red Chamber Chronicle was surprisingly simple.

From the very first day until now, this game has been developed entirely by me alone.

I am currently a university student. During my second year, I found myself feeling uncertain about my future and disconnected from my studies. I simply had the thought that perhaps I should try creating something I genuinely cared about.

That idea eventually led me to game development.

Without a mentor, without a team, and without a detailed plan, I began learning and building little by little.

Over time, this project became more than a game. It became something that helped me move through a difficult and uncertain period of life. The more I built, the more focused I became. Eventually, I found myself completely immersed in creating this world.

While reading novels, I became fascinated by fan interpretations of Dream of the Red Chamber. Many people loved these characters and stories, yet very few games truly allowed players to step inside that world.

So I asked myself:

Could the Red Chamber become more than a book?

Could it become a world where people can live, choose, and change their fate?

That simple question became the foundation of this project.

🧠 How I Made This Game

I am not a professional developer, nor did I begin with years of experience.

My development process has largely been:

Learn.

Build.

Start over.

Improve.

Repeat.

This project is not only a game—it is also a record of my own growth and learning journey.

❤️ Why Dream of the Red Chamber?

What first attracted me was not its status as a literary classic.

It was the feeling it left behind.

The beauty.

The restraint.

The regrets.

The subtle and complicated relationships between people.

I always felt that simply reading the story was not enough.

I wanted to give it another life.

Not as a novel.

But as a world.

🏗️ Current Development Status

Red Chamber Chronicle already features a freely explorable world and a growing life simulation system inspired by the original novel.

Current features include:

  • A freely explorable Grand View Garden and Jia family world

  • Dynamic NPC schedules and time progression systems

  • Character growth and life simulation activities

  • Branching storylines and multiple endings

  • An expanding world that continues to grow with development

The game is not yet complete, but it has already become a world that players can truly live in.

🌳 What It's Like Developing Alone

Sometimes it feels slow.

Sometimes it feels impossibly difficult.

But most of the time, it brings a quiet sense of fulfillment.

Because you are not simply finishing tasks on a checklist.

You are building a world with your own hands.

A place that gradually grows into something real.

🌱 A Final Note

The complete vision for Red Chamber Chronicle spans seventeen years of life within the world of the Red Chamber.

The upcoming demo will contain the first six years of this journey, offering a substantial introduction to the world, characters, and systems.

The remaining eleven years, along with additional storylines and life chapters, will continue to be developed and expanded over time.

Thank you for taking an interest in this project.

I sincerely hope you enjoy your time in this world.

About This Game

You arrive in Shanghai with an admission letter in your hand and your entire family’s expectations on your shoulders.

You think that if you just work hard enough, you’ll be able to build a life here.

This is not a power fantasy about changing your fate.

This is the real bill for ten years of trying.

Confidence and Pride

There is no health bar.

Your shield is confidence.
Your weak point is pride.

Being broke may force you to take humiliating, low-paying jobs. But protecting the fragile dignity of a straight-A student can cost you even more.

Swallow your pride and survive, or hold on to your dignity.

There is no third option.

What Hurts More Than Being Poor

Your anxiety doesn’t come from numbers alone.

It’s the roommate who effortlessly outperforms everything you worked so hard for.

It’s getting carried away, saying one thing too many — and then having her refuse to speak to you for an entire semester.

It’s holding hands with someone for an entire afternoon, while the words “big-city residency” and “a home already owned” hang silently between you, because neither of you wants to say them out loud.

Their lives become the ruler you use to measure your own.

And the reason you wake up at three in the morning.

You Can See the Road. You Just Can’t Take It.

Some choices are right there in front of you:

Studying abroad.
Starting a company.
Choosing another career.

But they’re locked behind greyed-out options.

It’s not because you didn’t try hard enough.

Some roads simply weren’t available from where you started.

Reconciliation

You betray someone’s trust because you desperately want to prove yourself.

You leave an old friend on read because facing them feels harder than running away.

And when every escape route is gone, you finally understand—

Reconciliation is not becoming someone other people envy.

It is looking at what is still left in your hands.

I gave this game ten years of my life.
I hope it can give you a little peace with yours.

Players explore distorted spaces filled with cursed objects, hidden passages, dangerous enemies, and strange ritual mechanisms while searching for materials used to craft weapons and tools.

魑魅：离人之歌是一款中国本土题材的悬疑剧情游戏。

故事发生在一个架空的以茶闻名的闽南古村——山隐村。

以一辆无人驾驶的大巴载着女性失踪在一个与神农架齐名的神秘古村庄里，揭开了故事的序幕。

推理系统：

真实与魔幻交织，人性与鬼神博弈。

真相究竟是什么，玩家需要扮演一名警察，通过验尸、推理和质询，抽丝剥茧，找到光怪陆离的案件背后的真相。

可爱互动：

可爱的卡通小人，配上风景如画的2.5d跑图，营造出全新的水墨画式灵异氛围。

玩家可以与其中的各种小动物、小物品互动，在探案之余享受惬意的温馨。

传统怀旧：

同时从千禧年的怀旧挂画中汲取灵感，结合故事所需的背景，打造出那个年代独有的物品。

那些小物品既是情绪的载体，亦是时代洪流的缩影，每个人都能在时光中找到自己怀念的过去，开启一场怀旧之旅。

轻度解谜：

添加了一些趣味的解谜互动玩法，但不会卡住玩家。

大胆试错，轻松游戏，只为诸君开怀一笑。
